messages.content: Make a video explaining how password reset works in our web app: the user says they forgot their password, the app looks up their account, emails them a one-time link, and the user opens it and chooses a new password.

I've drawn the password reset flow as a graph: the user, your web app, the users database, and the email service, with five steps from "Forgot password" to "New password." The app and the users database sit inside a "Your app" zone.

Does the graph look right? Tell me what to change, or approve it and I'll move on to the story.
The graph looks good. I approve it.
